title: Reading a small CSV file
description: A short explanation of headers and rows in a CSV file.
disclosure: Synthetic narration; prepared teaching examples. Includes reading pauses.

segments.title: Start with the header
segments.narration: The first row names the columns. Here, each later row contains a person's name and the city where they live.

screen.heading: A header followed by two records

segments.title: Find the matching value
segments.narration: Find the city associated with Grace. Read across the row, keeping each value under its column heading. Pause the lesson if you need more time.

screen.heading: Which city is listed for Grace?
bullets: Find Grace in the name column.
Read the city in the same row.
